beats.label: S1 · Vanessa wakes into the apocalypse
beats.text: Three years after vampires overran the world, Vanessa Seward wakes in a hospital and discovers her bite turns the vampire who feeds on her back into a human.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the premise and Vanessa's singular power, the engine of every later season.

beats.label: S1 · Doc restored, word spreads
beats.text: Vanessa turns the caged Doc human again, proving the power is repeatable, and Julius carries word up to Dmitri that a bloodline able to undo vampires walks the earth.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Vanessa's ability is not a fluke; the vampire hierarchy now hunts her specifically.

beats.label: S1 · Hospital falls, group flees
beats.text: Dmitri's elite soldiers overrun the hospital; the survivors escape in an armored ambulance and follow Axel to an abandoned military lab called the Farm.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Uproots the group and installs the Farm as the next-season location.

beats.label: S1 · The serial killer within
beats.text: The group's finger-collecting serial killer is first pinned on John and he is killed, then exposed as Sam; Vanessa cripples Sam and leaves him in the woods, where he is turned.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts Sam into vampiric orbit as a stalker of the group for seasons to come.

beats.label: S1 · Mohamad's bargain
beats.text: Mohamad has been trading with Dmitri for his sister Sheema's safety and lures Vanessa into what he claims is a refugee camp but is really Dmitri's blood farm.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Delivers Vanessa to Dmitri and defines Mohamad's guilt going into S2.

beats.label: S1 · Dylan revealed as vampire
beats.text: Dmitri captures Vanessa but she overpowers him after feeding on human blood; Rebecca then reveals her secret weapon — Vanessa's daughter Dylan, alive and turned.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Central emotional stake that opens S2 and drives Vanessa's early spiral.

beats.label: S1 · Axel emerges vampire
beats.text: As Vanessa reels from Dylan's fate, a turned Axel walks out of the sealed Farm; the two allies Vanessa trusted most are now on the wrong side of her bite.
beats.whyLoadBearing: S2 opens with Vanessa's closest people transformed; explains the cure-quest that follows.

cliffhanger.text: Vanessa has wounded Dmitri and just laid eyes on her turned daughter Dylan for the first time. Axel has walked out of the sealed Farm as a vampire himself.
questions: Can Vanessa turn Dylan back without killing her?
Will Axel remain a threat now that he is turned?
Who really runs the vampires now that Dmitri is broken?

characters.name: Vanessa Seward
characters.line: Resurrected mother whose bite reverses vampirism.

characters.name: Axel
characters.line: Marine who guarded Vanessa's body for three years; turned by Gorman inside the Farm at season's end.

characters.name: Doc
characters.line: Restored to human by Vanessa; carries guilt for locking a turned Axel inside the Farm and abandoning him.

characters.name: Mohamad
characters.line: Betrayed Vanessa to Dmitri in exchange for his sister Sheema's safety; now knows Sheema chose to stay with the vampires.

characters.name: Dylan
characters.line: Vanessa's daughter, found alive but turned into a vampire by Rebecca.

characters.name: Dmitri
characters.line: Ancient vampire ruler grievously wounded by Vanessa; obsessed with reviving the Elders.

characters.name: Rebecca
characters.line: Dmitri's lieutenant who was secretly plotting against him and produced Dylan as her leverage.

characters.name: Julius
characters.line: Powerful vampire who first hunted Vanessa; last seen answering to Dmitri after his failures.

characters.name: Sam
characters.line: Quiet friend revealed as the finger-collecting serial killer; left crippled in the woods and turned into a vampire.

beats.label: S2 · Dylan lost, Elder wakes
beats.text: Vanessa restores a starving Dylan to human, only for sunlight to reduce her to ash; her screams of grief awaken an ancient slumbering vampire, the First Elder.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes Vanessa's central hope and introduces the Elder mythology that structures S3.

beats.label: S2 · Sister revealed at the red door
beats.text: A masked hunter shadowing Vanessa reveals herself at the Farm as Scarlett Harker, Vanessa's blood sister; behind a red door they find a key hidden from Dmitri.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Scarlett as co-lead and puts the totem-key quest in motion.

beats.label: S2 · Sisterhood taken by Scab
beats.text: Scab murders the Sisterhood's leader Maya and takes her throne, dragging the coven behind Dmitri's hunt for the Elder and for Vanessa's key.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Elevates Scab as a running antagonist who outlives Dmitri.

beats.label: S2 · Sam turns Mohamad
beats.text: Trapped by Sam, Mohamad kills himself rather than turn; he rises as a vampire anyway and Sam finally has the disciple he was hunting for.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the Sam/Mohamad pack that shadows Vanessa through the next season.

beats.label: S2 · Mother revealed at Crooked Falls
beats.text: At the mountain redoubt of Crooked Falls, the leader turns out to be Abigail Van Helsing, mother to both sisters, and she leads Scarlett toward the Elder's tomb.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names Vanessa's bloodline and gives the Elder hunt a family guide.

beats.label: S2 · Abigail sacrifices, Dmitri dies
beats.text: Inside the tomb Abigail opens the final door at the cost of her life; the freed Elder is sworn to the Van Helsings, and Scarlett orders it to kill Dmitri and find Vanessa.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes Dmitri and hands Scarlett a bound Elder — a new balance of power.

beats.label: S2 · Elder bites Vanessa
beats.text: The Elder slaughters Blak-Tek where Vanessa lies captive and bites her; she wakes with red eyes, no longer purely herself.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Twists Vanessa's power at the moment she gains her greatest weapon, seeding her S3 darkness.

cliffhanger.text: The Elder has bitten Vanessa and her eyes have turned red. Dmitri is dead, but the Sisterhood under Scab is intact and Sam now has Mohamad as a vampire disciple.
questions: What has the Elder's bite done to Vanessa?
Will she hunt down the other Elders, or become one?
Who leads the vampires now that Dmitri is gone?

characters.name: Vanessa Van Helsing
characters.line: Just bitten by the First Elder inside Blak-Tek; her eyes have turned red.

characters.name: Scarlett Harker
characters.line: Vanessa's newly revealed sister; trained since childhood as a vampire hunter and now commanding the freed Elder.

characters.name: Axel
characters.line: Turned by Vanessa in a desperate cure and now bite-immune; back at her side.

characters.name: Doc
characters.line: Reunited with the group after abandoning Julius.

characters.name: Julius
characters.line: Bitten human by Vanessa and now allied with her; separated from the group after Crooked Falls.

characters.name: The First Elder
characters.line: Ancient vampire freed from the tomb, sworn by blood oath to the Van Helsing line.

characters.name: Sam
characters.line: Leapt from a tower and vanished; has now turned Mohamad and roams free with him.

characters.name: Mohamad
characters.line: Killed himself under Sam and rose as a vampire, still under Sam's control.

characters.name: Scab
characters.line: New leader of the Sisterhood, allied with the vampire cause.

characters.name: Flesh (Phil)
characters.line: With Lucky and Mohamad through the season, ending up at Crooked Falls; discovered his humanity holds firm.

beats.label: S3 · Elder killed for betrayal
beats.text: Vanessa kills the First Elder after it tries to send her to die inside a Van Helsing ancestor's memory; she and Scarlett hunt the other Elders and their totems.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Vanessa moves from student to hunter; establishes the totem quest driving the season.

beats.label: S3 · The Oracle chooses Sam
beats.text: A silent seer visits Sam and names him vessel of a fourth Elder if he sacrifices the one he loves; Sam kills his young protege Felix in the attempt.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the Oracle as the season's shaping force and begins Sam's ascension.

beats.label: S3 · Vanessa turns dark
beats.text: The Third Elder is Jacob Van Helsing, kin to the sisters; Vanessa tears him apart, strands Scarlett on his island, and murders an innocent man on the return.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Marks Vanessa's slide from hero to something colder that structures the finale.

beats.label: S3 · Denver falls
beats.text: Ivory, Scab, and the Sisterhood breach Denver and slaughter its people; Doc is coerced into weapons work by Blak-Tek and Julius flees with the surviving troops.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Displaces every human ally and sets Blak-Tek up as the human power going into S4.

beats.label: S3 · Mohamad restored, Axel immune
beats.text: Vanessa turns Mohamad human again and forbids him from following her; Scarlett forces a daywalker to bite a dying Axel, curing him and making him bite-immune.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reunites Axel with Scarlett and gives him the invulnerability he carries into S4.

beats.label: S3 · Sam becomes the Fourth Elder
beats.text: In the Hall of Elders the Seer freezes the fight and transforms Sam into a horned Fourth Elder as the ritual demands.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sam is now a demonic vessel, the season's antagonist ceiling and the S4 target.

beats.label: S3 · Scarlett dies, Lily rises
beats.text: Sam kills Mohamad, Scarlett impales herself on the blade in Vanessa's frozen hand, Axel walks out vowing hatred, and Vanessa's blood revives her ancestor Lily Van Helsing.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Cascading losses hand S4 a completely new configuration around Vanessa.

cliffhanger.text: Sam is now a horned Fourth Elder under the Oracle's command. Scarlett is dead, Axel has walked away vowing hatred, and Vanessa stands over her ancestor Lily Van Helsing, newly revived by her blood.
questions: Can Vanessa and Lily stop the Oracle from raising the Dark One?
Will Axel ever forgive Vanessa for Scarlett's death?
What is Blak-Tek building now that it has coerced Doc into service?

characters.name: Vanessa Van Helsing
characters.line: Increasingly brutal; alone in the crypt with a newly revived ancestor.

characters.name: Scarlett Harker
characters.line: Impaled herself on Vanessa's blade in the crypt to fulfil the ritual.

characters.name: Sam
characters.line: Transformed by the Oracle into the horned Fourth Elder.

characters.name: The Oracle / The Seer
characters.line: Silent mystical figure who selected Sam and drives the Elder ritual.

characters.name: Axel
characters.line: Bitten by a daywalker and now bite-immune; abandoned Vanessa vowing hatred after Scarlett's death.

characters.name: Doc
characters.line: Coerced by Blak-Tek to build weapons against the daywalkers.

characters.name: Julius
characters.line: Fled the fall of Denver; still human and separated from Vanessa's group.

characters.name: Flesh (Phil)
characters.line: Regenerating survivor; escaped the prison bus with Jolene and is en route to Loveland to find his wife.

characters.name: Ivory
characters.line: Sisterhood commander occupying the ruins of Denver alongside Scab.

characters.name: Lily Van Helsing
characters.line: 19th-century ancestor revived by Vanessa's spilled blood beside Scarlett's body.

beats.label: S4 · Lily lost, Oracle raises Michaela
beats.text: Lily is killed by ferals soon after her revival; the Oracle, now named as Bathory, drills Sam and resurrects the ancient Sisterhood founder Michaela.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes Vanessa's ancestor ally at once and expands the Oracle's cabal.

beats.label: S4 · Vanessa's engineered daughters
beats.text: Vanessa meets Jack and then Violet, both grown from her stolen ova; the three open a portal where Abraham Van Helsing warns them a Dark One waits in the Dark Realm.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the two Van Helsing sisters who carry the series from here on.

beats.label: S4 · Axel and Phil pulled aside
beats.text: Axel drifts into work for the warden Max at Loveland prison, where Phil finds his ex-wife Jennifer and their son Owen; Max is killed and Phil retires from the fight.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Accounts for Axel's separation from the main arc and writes Phil out of the war.

beats.label: S4 · Sam killed, Dracula revealed
beats.text: Sam and Bathory begin a ritual to make Sam the vessel of the Dark One, but the Dark One incinerates Sam on arrival and reveals herself as Dracula.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Kills Sam and names Dracula as the true antagonist for the rest of the series.

beats.label: S4 · Vanessa sealed in the Dark Realm
beats.text: Vanessa tricks Dracula into following her into the Dark Realm and traps them both there; Jack and Violet must find the missing Van Helsing pages to kill her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes Vanessa for most of the remaining runtime and shifts the sisters into the lead.

beats.label: S4 · Hansen's long game exposed
beats.text: Hansen is revealed as a turned acolyte of Abraham Van Helsing who spent decades engineering Jack and Violet to end Dracula; the Oracle then kills him for it.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Answers who made the sisters and why, then kills the only man who knew the plan.

beats.label: S4 · Dracula returns wearing Jack
beats.text: Jack and Violet enter the Dark Realm; only Dracula returns wearing Jack's face, kills the President and takes her office, while the real Jack lies in a coffin in the Realm.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season-ending body swap that defines the entire S5 problem.

cliffhanger.text: Dracula walks the earth wearing both the President's face and Jack's. Violet and Ivory have been gunned down trying to stop her, Axel and Julius lie wounded at the Sunshine Unit, and the real Jack is sealed inside a coffin in the Dark Realm.
questions: Can Jack escape the coffin, or return at all?
Who will realise Dracula is impersonating both Jack and the President?
What has Doc been forced to build at the Sunshine Unit?

characters.name: Vanessa Van Helsing
characters.line: Sealed inside the Dark Realm, having tricked Dracula into being trapped there with her.

characters.name: Jack Van Helsing
characters.line: Van Helsing sister grown from Vanessa's ova; sealed in a coffin in the Dark Realm.

characters.name: Violet
characters.line: Van Helsing sister grown from Vanessa's ova; last seen gunned down while trying to stop 'Jack'.

characters.name: Dracula / The Dark One
characters.line: Freed ancient vampire now impersonating both Jack and the President.

characters.name: The Oracle / Bathory
characters.line: Released again at season's end and once more at large.

characters.name: Axel
characters.line: Reunited with Julius but severely wounded and no longer healing at the Sunshine Unit.

characters.name: Julius
characters.line: Beside Axel at the Sunshine Unit, wounded and no longer healing.

characters.name: Ivory
characters.line: Sole surviving Sister, turned human by Violet and gunned down beside her.

characters.name: Doc
characters.line: Sent to the Sunshine Unit to build a cure; whereabouts unknown after the massacre there.

characters.name: Hansen
characters.line: Blak-Tek director exposed as Abraham Van Helsing's turned acolyte and killed by the Oracle.

beats.label: S5 · Jack sent to the past
beats.text: Vanessa opens a portal sending Jack to medieval Transylvania, where Michaela is preparing the noblewoman Olivia as the Dark One's host and Bathory hunts vampires as a human.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Origins of Dracula, Bathory and the amulet come out of Jack's past-set arc.

beats.label: S5 · The amulet forged
beats.text: Jack drains part of Dracula's power into an amulet, but Dracula turns Bathory before Jack can finish; Jack hands the amulet to the infant Van Helsing ancestor before leaving.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the amulet's origin and ties Bathory's turning into the present-day fight.

beats.label: S5 · Dracula tightens the noose
beats.text: Wearing the President's face, Dracula declares martial law; Violet and Ivory retrieve the amulet from Fort Collins and Dracula sends a Vanator to hunt them.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Political stakes and the hunter that eliminates the Sisterhood.

beats.label: S5 · Sisterhood ends, group reunites
beats.text: The remaining Sisters die shielding the amulet, Violet absorbs its power to banish the Vanator, and the survivors reunite with a revived Jack at a church where Julius dies.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Consolidates the surviving allies and removes Julius before the endgame.

beats.label: S5 · Vanessa returns as Nina
beats.text: Vanessa escapes the Dark Realm by absorbing her own inner darkness and enters Washington disguised as the vampire Nina, positioning herself at Dracula's side.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts Vanessa back in play and inside Dracula's inner circle for the finale.

beats.label: S5 · Bathory freed, Dracula whole again
beats.text: Jack bites Bathory back to human, but Dracula uses her remotely to open the amulet and free the last of her stolen power; Bathory jumps to her death to escape.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Restores Dracula to full power and sets the White House climax in motion.

beats.label: S5 · Vanessa's sacrifice ends it
beats.text: The Van Helsings paralyse Dracula with Bathory's scrolls; Vanessa traps the Dark One inside her own body, entering a coma as daylight returns and vampires turn human worldwide.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resolves the entire series in one act and defines the state everyone is left in.

cliffhanger.text: Vanessa lies in a death-like coma with the Dark One sealed inside her; Axel keeps watch over her body. Daylight has returned, vampires are human again, and Olivia adjusts to a world five centuries removed from her own.
questions: Will Vanessa ever wake, and if she does, will the Dark One come with her?
Can Olivia find a place in the world after five centuries as Dracula's vessel?
What will Jack, Violet and the survivors rebuild?

characters.name: Vanessa Van Helsing
characters.line: Sacrificed herself to seal the Dark One inside her body; lies in a death-like coma.

characters.name: Jack Van Helsing
characters.line: Lived through medieval Transylvania and returned; now helps Olivia adjust to the modern world.

characters.name: Violet
characters.line: Van Helsing sister who helped defeat Dracula and now aids Olivia alongside Jack.

characters.name: Olivia
characters.line: The medieval noblewoman who was Dracula's host body; freed and adjusting to modern life.

characters.name: Axel
characters.line: Standing vigil over Vanessa's comatose body.

characters.name: Ivory
characters.line: Sole surviving Sister; ally of the Van Helsings through the finale.

characters.name: Dracula / The Dark One
characters.line: Sealed inside Vanessa's body; no longer at large.

characters.name: Bathory
characters.line: Freed of the Dark One's mark by Jack's bite, but dead after leaping from a rooftop to escape Dracula's grip.
